Backlog spec called for auto-downgrade on drift. Our own 32 false-positive dead-link incident proved false invalidation is worse than stale verification. v1 flags drift for human review and never auto-downgrades; every finding carries downgrade_action "none — v1 flags drift for human review".
entries.before: Spec: on evidence drift, automatically downgrade the claim tier.
entries.after: Policy: on evidence drift, flag for human review. No automatic tier changes. Documented in UI, README, and finding schema.

entries.rationale: Deliberate, documented deviation from the backlog spec; reasoning recorded in the decision trail.
A VERIFIED badge nobody can check is a claim, not proof. Wire every VERIFIED placement badge to its signed trust-log proof page so trust becomes auditable.
entries.before: VERIFIED placement badges rendered as static labels with no link to evidence.
entries.after: VERIFIED badges link (new tab) to their trust-log claim proof pages. Badges render unlinked when no live proof exists — dead proof links are never shipped.
